Plugin.Name: Docker Template Editor
Plugin.Overview: A friendlier editor for the Docker container templates Unraid stores on the flash drive. Edit every variable, path, port, label and device in one searchable grid, paste a whole .env file, find & replace across all containers (for example /mnt/cache/appdata -> /mnt/user/appdata), edit raw XML, and roll back from automatic backups. Changes are applied with Unraid's own logic.
